commencement_date.value: March 1, 2004 (per Basic Lease Information), subject to postponement under sections 2.1/2.2 if possession or substantial completion of Landlord's improvements is later
commencement_date.note: Fixed date stated, but section 2.2 (applies given Landlord's Work in Addendum para 2) says term does not commence until improvements are substantially completed and possession delivered; actual date not confirmed in the text.

expiration_date.value: September 30, 2014 (127-month term), subject to extension if the Commencement Date is postponed
expiration_date.note: Consistent with 127 months from 3/1/2004; section 2.1 extends the Expiration Date for late delivery, so actual date may differ.

initial_monthly_base_rent.note: Addendum para 1 abates Base Rent (and CAM/tax/insurance contributions) for months 2 through 8 if Tenant is not in default; stated rate is the schedule rate.

rent_escalation.value: Stepped annual schedule each March 1: $6,277 (yr 1), $6,465, $6,659, $6,858, $7,064, $7,276, $7,495, $7,720, $7,951, $8,190, then $8,435 from 3/1/2014 to 9/30/2014 (roughly 3% per year). Additional rent for CAM, taxes and insurance is passed through pro rata.
rent_escalation.note: Percentage is calculated from the schedule, not stated in the lease. Controllable CAM increases are capped at 5% per annum from the second full calendar year (3.1(b)(i)).
rent_escalation.flag: value not visible in quote (derived or calculated)

renewal_option.note: No renewal or extension option appears in the Basic Lease Information, lease body or Addendum; section 2.4 states holdover does not extend the term.

renewal_notice_months.note: No renewal option exists in the text, so no notice period applies.

early_termination.value: None at Tenant's discretion. The only Tenant termination right is for eminent domain: if a substantial portion of the Premises is taken and the rest is unsuitable, notice within 30 days of the taking. Landlord has separate termination rights (casualty, condemnation, assignment/sublease request).
early_termination.normalised: No tenant early termination option; condemnation-only right
early_termination.quote: Tenant shall have the right to terminate this Lease if a substantial portion of the Premises is taken by exercise of the power of eminent domain
early_termination.note: No tenant termination option or fee is in the lease; the condemnation right is the only one found (section 12.1).

security_deposit.value: $6,277.00 cash security deposit, payable on signing
security_deposit.note: Separate from first month's Base Rent also due at signing (3.3(a)) and the $6,000 Tenant Improvement contribution (Addendum para 4).
